#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int count = 0;
    
    int i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < s.length() && s[j] == s[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        int len = j - i;
        if (len % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    
    std::cout << count;
    return 0;
}
